director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
haan, samajh aaya

Cricket pitch ka ek sira 0, doosra 1: batsman run lete hue beech mein ruk gaya. Beech ka mark 0 se ek gap par hai, aur 0 se 1 tak 2 barabar gaps hain: isliye 1/2. Ab line 3 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Ab line 3 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 3 sahi nahi hai. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Sadak 0 se 1 kilometre, 7 barabar gaps mein kati hai. Ek khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh ek pakki jagah hai, uska number 1/7 kilometre. Ab wahi sadak, 0 se 1, 6 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Khilona us par pehle mark par ruka: kitne kilometre par?
director.card: Ab wahi sadak, 0 se 1, 6 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Khilona us par pehle mark par ruka: kitne kilometre par?

seams.form: Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: one sixth

Haan, bilkul theek. Yeh sadak 6 barabar gaps mein kati hai, aur khilona ghar se bas ek gap chala, toh 1/6 kilometre par. Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain. 0 se 1 ki line 3 barabar gaps mein kati ho, toh 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Ab line 3 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

seams.form: Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain.

director.text: Nahi, 3 theek nahi. 3 toh gaps ki ginti hai, mark ka naam nahi; mark ke naam mein dono baatein aati hain: 0 se kitne gap chale, aur 0 se 1 tak kitne gap hain. Ab line 3 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Ab line 3 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: ek bata teen

Sahi jawab, kyunki 3 gaps mein se ek gap tak: 1/3. Ab 0 aur 1 ke beech 6 marks hain. Neeche wala number gaps se aata hai: 7 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/7 hai. Ab socho, ek aur line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hon, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. Wahan kitne gaps banenge?
director.card: Ab socho, ek aur line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hon, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. Wahan kitne gaps banenge?

director.text: 8 gap

Haan, sahi hai. Marks se gaps ek zyada: 7 marks, 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Gap zyada, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se ek gap door. Ab wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein bhi kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
director.card: Ab wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein bhi kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/10 wala

Bilkul sahi: jitne zyada gaps, utna chhota har gap: 10 gaps ke saath pehla mark 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas aata hai. Ab ek sawaal milkar, ek-ek kadam karke dekhte hain. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par hain. Board par abhi sirf beech wala khamba hai. 3 khambe raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatte hain?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, ek-ek kadam karke dekhte hain.

director.text: Nahi, yeh nahi hai. 3 khambe raaste ko 4 barabar gaps mein kaatte hain: ghar se pehle khambe tak ek gap, aur aakhri khambe se school tak bhi ek. Doori gaps se naapte hain, khambon se nahi: khamba bas ek jagah hai, aur ghar se pehle khambe tak ka chalna ek gap hai. Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: 1/3 km

1/3 km sahi nahi hai. Ek aur dhang se samajhte hain. Darzi ka ribbon 0 se 1 metre tak hai, aur us par 4 chalk ke marks hain. Marks 4 hain, par gap 5 bante hain, isliye pehla mark 1/5 metre par hai. Socho, wahi ribbon 12 barabar gaps mein kaat rahe ho. Beech mein kitne chalk ke marks lagenge?
director.card: Socho, wahi ribbon 12 barabar gaps mein kaat rahe ho. Beech mein kitne chalk ke marks lagenge?

seams.form: Ek aur dhang se samajhte hain.

director.text: gyarah marks lagenge
Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 12 barabar gaps ke beech 11 marks hote hain, gaps se ek kam. Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain. Ghar se pehle khambe tak kitne kilometre hain?
director.card: Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?

seams.form: Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain.

director.text: 1/4 kilometer

Sahi jawab. 4 barabar gaps mein har gap 1/4 kilometre ka hai, aur pehla khamba 0 se theek ek gap par khada hai. Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 kilometre door hai. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: samajh nahi aaya
Neeche wala number marks nahi, gaps ginta hai. 0 aur 1 ke beech ke 10 marks se jitne gaps bane, wahi neeche wala number hai. 10 marks wali is line par pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Yeh 0 se 1 tak ki ek poori patti hai, barabar gaps mein kati, aur abhi koi gap rangin nahi. Gaps ke beech ke kinaare wahi marks hain jo line par the. Ab tum batao.
director.card: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 1/10 sahi nahi hai. 1/10 tab hota jab 0 se 1 ki line 10 barabar gaps mein hoti; par yahan 10 marks hain, aur 0 ke baad aur 1 se pehle bhi ek-ek gap hai. Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 1/11 hai na

Haan, bilkul theek: 10 marks se line ke 11 barabar gaps bante hain, aur pehla mark ek gap par hai, yaani 1/11. Line ek baar 4 barabar gaps mein kati hai, ek baar 12 mein. Inke marks mein 0 ke sabse paas wala mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Line ek baar 4 barabar gaps mein kati hai, ek baar 12 mein. Inke marks mein 0 ke sabse paas wala mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: Hindi mein bolo
Theek hai, Hindi mein kehti hoon. Ek baar line ko 4 gap mein kaata, ek baar 12 mein. Inmein se jo mark 0 se sabse kam door hai, use kis fraction se bulayenge?
director.card: Ek baar line ko 4 gap mein kaata, ek baar 12 mein. Inmein se jo mark 0 se sabse kam door hai, use kis fraction se bulayenge?

seams.form: Theek hai, Hindi mein kehti hoon.

director.text: Nahi, 1/4 theek nahi. Ise ek baar aise sochte hain. Yahan 2 barabar gap bhi hain, aur 5 bhi. Gap jitne zyada, har gap utna chhota: 1/5 ka gap 1/2 wale se chhota. Pehla mark 1/5 hai, aur line 7 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 1/7 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/5 ke beech, ya 1/5 ke baad?
director.card: Pehla mark 1/5 hai, aur line 7 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 1/7 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/5 ke beech, ya 1/5 ke baad?

seams.form: Ise ek baar aise sochte hain.

director.text: after 1/5

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. 1/7 ko aage rakha kyunki 7 bada hai; par 7 gap bhi wahi 0 se 1 bharte hain; socho, 7 wala gap 5 wale se lamba hoga ya chhota. Batao, 1/7 ka mark 0 aur 1/5 ke beech lagega, ya 1/5 ke baad?
director.card: Pehla mark 1/5 hai, aur line 7 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 1/7 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/5 ke beech, ya 1/5 ke baad?

director.text: ruko, main khud karti hoon
Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: Pehla mark 1/5 hai, aur line 7 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 1/7 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/5 ke beech, ya 1/5 ke baad?

director.text: between 0 and 1/5 hai na

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 1/7 ka gap 1/5 ke gap se chhota hai, toh 1/7 wala mark 0 aur 1/5 ke beech aata hai. Ab us sawaal par lautte hain jo humne pehle chhoda tha. Line ek baar 4 barabar gaps mein kati hai, ek baar 12 mein. Inke marks mein 0 ke sabse paas wala mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Line ek baar 4 barabar gaps mein kati hai, ek baar 12 mein. Inke marks mein 0 ke sabse paas wala mark kaunsa fraction hai?

seams.form: Ab us sawaal par lautte hain jo humne pehle chhoda tha.

director.text: Sahi jawab. 12 barabar gaps ka har gap 4 wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/12 wala pehla mark 0 ke sabse paas hai. Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?
director.card: Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?

director.text: pehle mark pe 1/9 hai

Haan, sahi hai: 1/9 matlab 9 barabar gaps mein se 1 gap, toh 1/9 ki jagah 0 se ek gap par, pehle mark par hai. Ab 0 se ek se zyada gap chalenge, aur fraction ka upar wala number batayega kitne. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe cricket pasand hai

Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh number line wala kaam khatam ho jaaye. Abhi apne kaam par wapas chalte hain. Is baar line 3 barabar gaps mein kati hai, har gap 1/3. 0 se 2 gap chalo, ek, do, aur hum 2/3 par aa gaye. 2/3 ek hi jagah hai, ek hi number. Yahan tak saaf hai?

seams.form: Abhi apne kaam par wapas chalte hain.

director.text: kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara
Wah, cricket ki baat sambhaal ke rakhi hai, baad mein zaroor sunungi. Is baar line 8 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 0 se 5 gap chalo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?
director.card: Is baar line 8 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 0 se 5 gap chalo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?

director.text: 8/5 sahi nahi hai. Tumne 8 ko fraction mein upar rakha, jaise 8 gap chale ho; par chalne sirf 5 gap the. Socho, upar kaunsi ginti aati hai. 8 barabar gaps wali line par 0 se 5 gap chalo: kaunsa fraction?
director.card: Is baar line 8 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 0 se 5 gap chalo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?

director.text: Nahi, 8/5 theek nahi. 8 gaps wali taraf 0 se ek-ek gap chalo aur paanch tak gino. Phir dekho, poore 1 tak aise kitne gap hain. Chalo, ab tumhari baari.
director.card: Is baar line 8 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 0 se 5 gap chalo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?

director.text: 5/8 par
Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki har gap 1/8 ka, aur aise 5 gap mile toh 5/8. Sixer ki baat tumne ki thi: tab tumhare saath kaun tha?
Rohit

Oho, Rohit! Yeh achhi baat batayi. Theek hai, ab phir se dhyaan idhar lagate hain. Ab 1/3 wale 3 gap chalkar dekho: teesre gap ke ant par hum theek 1 par hain, isliye wahan 3/3 = 1. Teeno gap milkar 0 se 1 tak ki poori line bhar dete hain. Ab tak samajh aaya?

seams.form: Theek hai, ab phir se dhyaan idhar lagate hain.

j2.line: Oho, Rohit! Yeh achhi baat batayi.

director.text: aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
chauka
Wah, chauka! Toh tumhara favourite yahi hai. Ab phir se apne kaam ki taraf chalte hain. Ab socho, ek doosri line 1/5 wale gaps mein kati ho. 0 se theek 1 tak aise kitne gap chalne honge?

seams.form: Ab phir se apne kaam ki taraf chalte hain.

director.text: 5 hai na

Sahi jawab. 1/5 ke 5 gap se 5/5 = 1. Ab line ke 6 barabar gaps hain. Beech ka mark 3/6 = 1/2 hai, kyunki 3, 6 ka aadha hai. 2/6 usse pehle aata hai, 5/6 baad mein. 0 se 1 ki ek nayi line 10 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 4/10 beech se pehle aayega, ya beech ke baad?
director.card: 0 se 1 ki ek nayi line 10 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 4/10 beech se pehle aayega, ya beech ke baad?

director.text: pehle aayega

Haan, bilkul theek: 10 gaps ka beech 5 gap par hai, 5/10; 4/10 usse ek gap pehle hai, toh beech se pehle. Aao, agla sawaal hum dono mil ke hal karenge. Ek number line 0 se 1 tak hai. Is par 2/5 ka mark dhoondhna hai. 2/5 mein kaunsa number line ke barabar gaps ginta hai: 2 ya 5?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal hum dono mil ke hal karenge.

Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge.
